validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <transition event="go, stop" target="b"/>
    <transition event="bad!event" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: event descriptors are whitespace-separated, not comma-separated
notes: `event` is a whitespace-separated list of descriptors (`a`, `a.b`, `a.*`, `*`); commas and other punctuation never match
diagnostics.help: replace commas with spaces; each descriptor is matched independently

diagnostics.message: event descriptor `bad!event` contains an invalid character
notes: `event` is a whitespace-separated list of descriptors (`a`, `a.b`, `a.*`, `*`); commas and other punctuation never match
diagnostics.help: use XML name-style event descriptors containing letters, digits, `_`, `-`, `:`, and `.`; `*` and `.*` are wildcard descriptors
